findings.text: the done-when says the test "runs the watcher's tick over a fixture of three sessions", then enumerates four mutually exclusive cases: an eleven-minute session that is swept, a nine-minute session that is not, a foreign-host session that is not, and an eleven-minute session with a live follower registration that is not; a single session cannot be both the swept eleven-minute one and the live-follower one, so the fixture cannot be three

findings.reason: as written the fixture supplies nothing for the control to redden, so the node's one control on session confinement cannot fire and its gate would pass on an unfiltered sweep, which is exactly the state the section's own comment says was merged.
findings.text: the fixture description gives only the eleven-minute session a "scoring run's review is dispatched" and calls the nine-minute session merely "not swept", yet both the "in the same tick, a scoring run belonging to the nine-minute session is not reviewed" assertion and the declared negative control ("with the watcher calling `sweep` without the session, the nine-minute session's scoring run is reviewed and the test fails") require the nine-minute session to own a scoring run; the section's own comment `c-s37-merged-not-landed` records the consequence — "the done-when's declared control, dropping the session from the watcher's `sweep` call, no longer fails on the reworked fixture, so nothing guards the session confinement"
